summary: Enhance employee performance with our Goal Setting and KPI Development training course. Equip your team with essential skills for measurable success.
lede: KPI training and development covers turning organizational priorities into measurable goals and indicators. It is for managers, team leaders, HR professionals, and employees who set or review performance expectations, and develops practical skills in writing SMART goals, choosing meaningful KPIs for different roles, monitoring progress with data and targets, and using reviews to guide feedback and improvement.
audienceIntro: This course is designed for professionals who regularly set, agree, or review goals and KPIs.
modules: Foundations of Goal Setting and KPIs
Designing SMART Goals That Actually Work
Defining Effective KPIs for Different Roles
Performance Conversations Using Goals and KPIs
Aligning Goals with Development and Career Growth
Avoiding Gaming, Overload, and Misaligned KPIs
Goal Setting and KPIs in Public Sector and NGOs
Embedding a Performance and Results Culture
prerequisites: Participants should have a basic understanding of organizational operations and an interest in performance management. Prior experience in managing or setting goals is beneficial but not mandatory.
